headline: MIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.50 at PIT 4.35, with a projected total of 7.85. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: MIN moved -0.80 runs while PIT moved +0.14, changing the projected margin by -0.94 runs. The projected total fell -0.66, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Bailey Ober has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Spencer Horwitz, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Ryan Kreidler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
